newsitem.title: UK: European bunker prices steady to firmer, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: European bunker prices steady to firmer, trade thin.

text.p: European bunker prices were steady to firmer on Monday on the back of stronger crude and gas oil markets, but trade was thin with the price rise keeping buyers scarce, brokers said.
Rotterdam high sulphur bunkers were assessed steady around $91/$92 fob with limited volume traded around $91. Prices for diesel and gas oil bunkers edged higher on the back of firmer gas oil futures.
Tight prompt supplies kept prices edging higher in Hamburg.
In the Mediterranean prices for fuel oils were mostly stable while diesel and gas oil made small gains though buying interest for both was thin.
In Durban, prices for low sulphur fuel oil bunkers were marked up $1 on the back of stronger crude while tight supplies saw diesel and gas oil pegged around $3 firmer.
